services.name: Capt. Cook /Kealakekua Bay Marine Adventure
services.desc: Duration 4 Hours Cruise coastline and explore sea caves and other historical areas where ancient Hawaiians made history and created legends. Join us for a guided tour to Kealakekua Bay and watch wild marine life as we travel, such as dolphins or whales (seasonal). Lunch is served while enjoying the beauty of the Bay. Schedule: Check-in at Honokohau Harbor. Fitting snorkel gear and safety briefing. Depart Honokohau Harbor Head over to Kealakekua Bay /Capt. services.name: Whale Watch
services.desc: Tour Description: Humpback Whales yearly arrive in the Hawaiian Islands after a 3,000 mile journey to breed, have calf and to nurse there young. Duration 3 Hours Our 3hour journey aboard our modern 24 passenger catamaran that is designed for open oceans conditions will allow our passengers to sit back, relax and enjoy breathtaking views of the beautiful Island of Hawaii and watch the humpback whales. services.name: Private Charter
services.desc: Are you looking to relax with your family or friends? Wedding Party, Birthday, Family Reunion, School Trips, etc. Look no further! Our Private Charter is all about you. It can be morning snorkel, afternoon cruise or night manta snorkel, it’s up to you! Create your own adventure with us, whether it is snorkeling or just cruising along the coast. Let us know what’s in your interest and we’ll give you some ideas of what’s best. We can customize a tour specific to your likings and the size of your party. We have few different options of boats available and can accommodate a tour for even 144 people!!! Call or e-mail us for more
